verdict.rationale: Framer is a SaaS website builder with a desktop and editor client, so letting users opt out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry opt-out, a usage-tracking control, or any data-collection setting. Password protection, branching and locale redirects are unrelated features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
